title: Say mareen a boses na lawak
intro: Pawil ed apalabas ed sakey a makapanyarin totoo ya akaawat na sakey a mabilay a pakelaw bilang subok. Say inka-arogante tan inka-masebeg so amawala na kapalaran da. Sarag mon tumboken so istorya tan naamtaan no antoy agawa ed sayan makapadinayew ya pananguman?
clues: Nibaki ak bilang sakey a madibinon subok ed sakey a makapanyarin totoon kabkabat ed biskeg tan inkasumlang da.
Sakey ak ya nikadkaduman pankelawan—say singa siak et agnin balot pinmatnag ed limog da.
Inabang ko so danum ya inumen ed bobon ed saray totook diad nanduruman agew.
Pinasakbayan ira ya antokaman a pakasakitan ed siak et mangitarok na maples a dusa.
Say sanka-makpel ed sikara et agto inimano so pasakbay tan binugbog to ak.
Kayari na impatey ko, sakey labat a maksil ya eyag a nanlapud tagey so aneral ed intiron totook.

trial.label: Say kapalaran ko
options: Inawit a tampol ed sakey a panarian

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a kaban a gawad kiew
Sakey a tronon balitok tan pilak

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Naderal na sakey labat ya eyag
outcome.answer: Naderal na sakey labat ya eyag

verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
